## Download All Materials

Download combined PDFs of all released materials:

| Bundle | Download |
|--------|----------|
| All Problem Sets | [PDF](files/bundles/ECON1550_problem_sets_bundle.pdf){.bundle-link} |
| All Slides | [PDF](files/bundles/ECON1550_slides_bundle.pdf){.bundle-link} |
| Complete Course Materials | [PDF](files/bundles/ECON1550_complete_bundle.pdf){.bundle-link} |

<script>
(function() {
  function processPage() {
    // Fetch both timestamps and release manifest
    Promise.all([
      fetch('files/file_timestamps.json').then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(() => null),
      fetch('files/release_manifest.json').then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(() => null)
    ]).then(([timestampData, releaseData]) => {
      const files = timestampData?.files || {};
      const hasTimestamps = Boolean(timestampData && timestampData.files);
      const assignments = releaseData?.assignments || [];
      const timezone = releaseData?.timezone || 'America/New_York';

      // Build lookup by assignment ID
      const assignmentById = {};
      assignments.forEach(a => { assignmentById[a.id] = a; });

      // Get current time
      const now = new Date();

      // Helper: check if a date string has passed
      function hasDatePassed(isoString) {
        if (!isoString) return false;
        const date = new Date(isoString);
        return now >= date;
      }

      function getFilesPath(href) {
        if (!href) return null;
        try {
          const url = new URL(href, document.baseURI);
          const normalized = url.pathname.replace(/^\/+/, '');
          const marker = normalized.indexOf('files/');
          return marker === -1 ? null : normalized.slice(marker);
        } catch (_) {
          const marker = href.indexOf('files/');
          return marker === -1 ? null : href.slice(marker);
        }
      }

      // Helper: disable a link (convert to plain text)
      function disableLink(link) {
        if (link.classList.contains('link-disabled')) return;
        link.classList.add('link-disabled');
        link.removeAttribute('href');
        link.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
        link.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      }

      // Helper: extract pset ID from href (e.g., "files/psets/pset1/pset1.pdf" -> "pset1")
      function extractPsetId(href) {
        const match = href.match(/psets\/(pset\d+)\//);
        return match ? match[1] : null;
      }

      // Helper function to add last-updated row to a table row
      // compact: if true, merge date into first column (e.g. "Last updated Jan 25")
      function addLastUpdatedRow(row, labelText, compact) {
        if (row.nextElementSibling && row.nextElementSibling.classList.contains('last-updated-row')) return;

        const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td');
        const timestamps = [];
        let hasAnyTimestamp = false;
        let firstDate = '';

        cells.forEach((cell, idx) => {
          if (idx === 0) {
            timestamps.push(labelText);
            return;
          }
          const link = cell.querySelector('a[href*="files/"]');
          if (link) {
            const href = link.getAttribute('href');
            if (!href) {
              timestamps.push('');
              return;
            }
            const path = getFilesPath(href);
            if (!path) {
              timestamps.push('');
              return;
            }
            const timestamp = files[path];
            if (timestamp) {
              hasAnyTimestamp = true;
              const date = new Date(timestamp);
              const formatted = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
                month: 'short',
                day: 'numeric'
              });
              if (!firstDate) firstDate = formatted;
              timestamps.push(compact ? '' : formatted);
            } else {
              timestamps.push('');
            }
          } else {
            timestamps.push('');
          }
        });

        if (hasAnyTimestamp) {
          if (compact && firstDate) timestamps[0] = labelText + ' ' + firstDate;
          row.classList.add('has-updated-row');
          const newRow = document.createElement('tr');
          newRow.className = 'last-updated-row';
          timestamps.forEach((text, idx) => {
            const td = document.createElement('td');
            td.textContent = text;
            if (idx === 0) td.className = 'last-updated-label';
            else td.className = 'last-updated-date';
            newRow.appendChild(td);
          });
          row.parentNode.insertBefore(newRow, row.nextSibling);
        }
      }

      // Build slides lookup by deck number from release manifest
      const slidesByDeckNum = {};
      assignments.forEach(a => {
        if (a.kind !== 'slides') return;
        const m = a.id.match(/^slides-(\d+)/);
        if (m) slidesByDeckNum[m[1]] = a;
      });

      // Process tables: disable unreleased links
      document.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(table => {
        const rows = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr'));
        const headerRow = table.querySelector('thead tr');
        const headers = headerRow ? Array.from(headerRow.querySelectorAll('th')).map(th => th.textContent.trim()) : [];

        // Check if this is the slides table
        const isSlidesTable = headers.includes('Topic') && headers.includes('PDF');
        // Check if this is the problem sets table
        const isPsetTable = headers.includes('Problem Set') && headers.includes('Questions');

        rows.forEach(row => {
          const firstCell = row.querySelector('td:first-child');
          if (!firstCell) return;

          // Problem sets table: check release status and disable unreleased links
          if (isPsetTable && firstCell.textContent.includes('Problem Set')) {
            const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td');

            // Find the pset ID from any link in the row
            let psetId = null;
            cells.forEach(cell => {
              const link = cell.querySelector('a[href*="files/psets/"]');
              if (link && !psetId) {
                psetId = extractPsetId(link.getAttribute('href'));
              }
            });

            if (psetId) {
              const assignment = assignmentById[psetId];
              if (assignment) {
                const questionsReleased = hasDatePassed(assignment.pre_release_at_local);
                const solutionsReleased = hasDatePassed(assignment.sol_release_at_local);

                cells.forEach(cell => {
                  const link = cell.querySelector('a');
                  if (!link) return;
                  const href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';

                  // Questions and Source links: require questions release
                  if (href.includes('pset') && !href.includes('_answers')) {
                    if (!questionsReleased) {
                      disableLink(link);
                    }
                  }
                  // Solutions link: require solutions release
                  if (href.includes('_answers')) {
                    if (!solutionsReleased) {
                      disableLink(link);
                    }
                  }
                });
              }
            }

            // Add timestamp row (only for released items)
            addLastUpdatedRow(row, 'Last updated');
          }
          // Slides table: disable unreleased and un-annotated, add timestamps for released
          else if (isSlidesTable) {
            const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td');
            cells.forEach(cell => {
              const link = cell.querySelector('a[href*="files/slides/"]');
              if (!link) return;
              const href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
              const slideMatch = href.match(/slides\/(\d+)-/);
              if (slideMatch) {
                const assignment = slidesByDeckNum[slideMatch[1]];
                // Disable if slide is unreleased
                if (assignment && !hasDatePassed(assignment.pre_release_at_local)) {
                  disableLink(link);
                  return;
                }
              }
              // Disable if file was not staged (only when timestamps loaded successfully)
              if (hasTimestamps) {
                const path = getFilesPath(href);
                if (path && !files[path]) {
                  // For annotated links, show "\u2014" instead of disabled "PDF"
                  if (href.includes('-annotated')) {
                    link.textContent = '\u2014';
                  }
                  disableLink(link);
                }
              }
            });
            // For slides, show the most recent timestamp across PDF + Annotated
            const allLinks = row.querySelectorAll('a[href*="files/slides/"]');
            let latestDate = null;
            allLinks.forEach(link => {
              const href = link.getAttribute('href');
              if (!href) return;
              const path = getFilesPath(href);
              if (path && files[path]) {
                const d = new Date(files[path]);
                if (!latestDate || d > latestDate) latestDate = d;
              }
            });
            if (latestDate) {
              const formatted = latestDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
              // Insert custom last-updated row
              if (!row.nextElementSibling || !row.nextElementSibling.classList.contains('last-updated-row')) {
                row.classList.add('has-updated-row');
                const newRow = document.createElement('tr');
                newRow.className = 'last-updated-row';
                const numCols = row.querySelectorAll('td').length;
                const td = document.createElement('td');
                td.colSpan = numCols;
                td.className = 'last-updated-label';
                td.textContent = 'Last updated ' + formatted;
                newRow.appendChild(td);
                row.parentNode.insertBefore(newRow, row.nextSibling);
              }
            }
          }
        });
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('a.bundle-link').forEach(link => {
        const href = link.getAttribute('href');
        const path = getFilesPath(href);
        if (!path || !files[path]) {
          disableLink(link);
        }
      });

      // Add "Last updated" rows to the bundles table
      document.querySelectorAll('a.bundle-link').forEach(link => {
        const row = link.closest('tr');
        if (row) addLastUpdatedRow(row, 'Last updated', true);
      });

      // Process other links (lecture notes) with inline dates; disable if not staged
      document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="files/"]').forEach(link => {
        if (link.classList.contains('bundle-link')) return;
        // Skip links in tables (they have row-based dates)
        if (link.closest('table')) return;

        if (link.nextSibling && link.nextSibling.className === 'file-updated') return;
        const href = link.getAttribute('href');
        const path = getFilesPath(href);
        if (!path) return;
        const timestamp = files[path];
        if (timestamp) {
          const date = new Date(timestamp);
          const formatted = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
            month: 'short',
            day: 'numeric'
          });
          const span = document.createElement('span');
          span.className = 'file-updated';
          // Use "last updated" for main lecture notes PDF, "upd." for chapters
          const isMainLectureNotes = href.includes('lecture_notes_ECON1550.pdf');
          span.textContent = isMainLectureNotes ? ` (last updated ${formatted})` : ` (upd. ${formatted})`;
          link.parentNode.insertBefore(span, link.nextSibling);
        } else {
          // File not in timestamps means it was not staged (unreleased)
          disableLink(link);
        }
      });

      // Add aria-labels to links with generic repeated text for accessibility
      document.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(table => {
        const hdr = table.querySelector('thead tr');
        const cols = hdr ? Array.from(hdr.querySelectorAll('th')).map(th => th.textContent.trim()) : [];
        const isSlidesTbl = cols.includes('Topic') && cols.includes('PDF');
        const isPsetTbl = cols.includes('Problem Set') && cols.includes('Questions');
        if (!isSlidesTbl && !isPsetTbl) return;

        table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr:not(.last-updated-row)').forEach(row => {
          const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td'));
          if (cells.length === 0) return;
          const rowLabel = cells[0].textContent.trim();
          cells.forEach((cell, idx) => {
            if (idx === 0) return;
            const link = cell.querySelector('a');
            if (!link) return;
            if (isSlidesTbl) {
              const href = (link.getAttribute('href') || '');
              const isAnnotated = href.includes('-annotated');
              link.setAttribute('aria-label', rowLabel + (isAnnotated ? ' annotated slides (PDF)' : ' slides (PDF)'));
            } else if (isPsetTbl) {
              link.setAttribute('aria-label', rowLabel + ' \u2013 ' + link.textContent.trim());
            }
          });
        });
      });
    }).catch(err => console.error('Materials page error:', err));
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', processPage);
  } else {
    processPage();
  }
})();
</script>

<style>
/* Slides table: fit columns to content */
.slides-table table {
  width: auto;
}
.slides-table table td:first-child,
.slides-table table th:first-child {
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.slides-table table td:nth-child(2),
.slides-table table th:nth-child(2),
.slides-table table td:nth-child(3),
.slides-table table th:nth-child(3) {
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-align: center;
}
.file-updated {
  color: #6b7280;
  font-size: 0.85em;
}
.has-updated-row td {
  border-bottom: none !important;
  padding-bottom: 0.1em !important;
}
.last-updated-row {
  font-size: 0.85em;
}
.last-updated-row td {
  padding-top: 0 !important;
  padding-bottom: 0.4em !important;
  color: #6b7280;
}
.last-updated-row td.last-updated-label {
  font-style: italic;
  padding-left: 1.5em !important;
}
.last-updated-date {
}
/* Disabled links (unreleased content) */
a.link-disabled {
  color: #6b7280 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  cursor: default !important;
}
</style>
